description.value: Cilantro Indian Cuisine is a full-service Indian restaurant on West Broadway serving a broad menu of North and South Indian dishes alongside Indo-Chinese fusion items, with freshly ground spices and house-made chutneys. The kitchen has over 20 years of experience spanning India, Malaysia, the UK, and North America, and the Vancouver location is a second outpost of an original White Rock restaurant. Touring cyclists will find a wide range of dietary accommodations including vegan, gluten-free, and Jain dishes, plus online ordering for convenient takeout.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: wall_loops (16 spaces, covered) at 21m; wall_loops (16 spaces, covered) at 22m; wall_loops (16 spaces, covered) at 22m; wall_loops (16 spaces, covered) at 25m; stands (6 spaces) at 95m. Total: 70 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is fully accessible and confirms the restaurant at 189 W Broadway, Vancouver with phone (604) 875-0007. Online ordering cart and 'Order Now' functionality confirm takeout. Website FAQ explicitly confirms vegan, gluten-free, and Jain options. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the site content.
concerns: Website home page claims 'spectacular beachfront views' but 189 West Broadway is inland Vancouver, not on the waterfront — this language likely refers to the White Rock location and appears to be copy-paste error on the Vancouver site.
OSM record has no phone number; (604) 875-0007 sourced from website only, so phone contact_confirmed set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a functioning website and online ordering. Confirmed open.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states: 'we offer a variety of vegan and gluten free options' and 'we offer a variety of Jain dishes.' Menu includes many vegetarian and vegan items
